evidence: Reviewed body at decompiled/main/main_0116.c:8324-8360 and callers f_7000fafaf0/f_7000fb1e48. It queries attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x13, branches on statuses 6 and 7, and conditionally passes the input pointer to an unidentified helper before clamping the returned byte to 0x15. The exact meaning of the helper result is not recovered, so no semantic name is proposed.

decompiled/main/main_0057.c:43115-43164 checks attribute-context selector 0x13 against status values 3, nonzero, 4, and 8, then applies three predicate helpers to the input record. If those gates pass, it obtains/uses the record pointer, reads a 32-bit value at byte offset 0x24, clears mask 0x8000, and stores the result back (lines 43145-43159). Caller f_70006abf30 passes a record pointer at decompiled/main/main_0057.c:22939-22943. The flag meaning is not established.

Callers f_7001011fc8 and f_700101acf0 store/use its x0 result at decompiled/main/main_0119.c:4884-4888 and 14036-14040. The property’s domain label is unknown, so the name identifies only the observed conversion.

decompiled/main/main_0088.c:43657-43763 takes a record pointer, calls f_7000cec588 on a sequence of subobject addresses spanning offsets 0x410 through 0x3600 at regular 0x178-byte intervals, then tail-calls format_season_record_detail with the original pointer. Caller reset_context_and_process_league_games_state invokes it at decompiled/main/main_0088.c:47357-47360 after resetting a field in that record; callers f_7000ce86ec/f_7000ce8850 also invoke it on their record at lines 39973-39977 and 40074-40078. This supports initialization of season-record detail blocks but not field names.

decompiled/main/main_0112.c:42781-42837 rejects unsupported selector/record cases, fetches attribute-context status and a context value (lines 42787-42799), then compares the float in vector register 0 against constants 1.0, 0.6, 0.55, 0.45, and 0.4 (42800-42823), returning bucket codes 5 through 1 or the lower fallback code.
